subject: maths
question: Ajay invests a certain sum of money on simple interest at 8% p.a. for 15 years. If the interest earned by him is Rs. 58,410, then find the sum invested by him.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total **simple interest** percentage for the period = Rate × Time

⇒ Total Interest % = 8% × 15 = 120%

Given, 120% of the **sum invested** = ₹58,410

⇒ 100% (Principal) = (58,410 ÷ 120) × 100 = 486.75 × 100 = ₹48,675

**∴ The correct answer is ₹48,675.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Interest earned (SI)** = ₹58,410

**Rate (R)** = 8% p.a.

**Time (T)** = 15 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19e20f12dd926d1e83acf6ffe071199cbac83a0510eb74a02fbe26afe232b000.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 58,410 = (P × 8 × 15) ÷ 100

⇒ 58,410 = (P × 120) ÷ 100

⇒ 58,410 = P × 1.2

⇒ P = 58,410 ÷ 1.2

⇒ P = 584,100 ÷ 12

⇒ P = 48,675

**∴ The correct answer is ₹48,675.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

It is the interest calculated only on the initial principal amount. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Total Amount (A)

The sum of the principal and interest earned over a period. Formula: A = P + SI = P[1 + (RT ÷ 100)].

Finding Principal

When interest is given, the sum invested (Principal) is calculated as P = (SI × 100) ÷ (R × T).
